note_text: Patient said she never got any reminder message and completely forgot about the visit. Wants to rebook for next week.
summary: Patient missed the appointment because she did not receive a reminder message and forgot. She requested to rebook for next week.
recommended_action: Verify patient contact details and automated reminder settings, then assist the patient with rebooking for next week.

note_text: Lives far from the clinic and could not find any transport that morning. Says the clinic is too far for a routine check-up.
summary: Patient missed the appointment due to living far from the clinic and lacking available transportation that morning.
recommended_action: Explore offering telehealth appointments for routine check-ups or provide patient transportation assistance resources.

note_text: Patient felt the consultation fee was too high this month and decided to skip. Asked if there is any discount for follow-ups.
summary: Patient skipped the appointment due to high consultation fees and asked about available discounts for follow-up visits.
recommended_action: Inform the patient about available payment plans, financial assistance options, or follow-up discount structures.

summary: No operational note or reason for the missed appointment was provided.
recommended_action: Verify data collection processes to ensure staff record reasons for missed appointments.

note_text: Had high fever and body ache on the day, stayed in bed. Will visit once recovered.
summary: Patient missed the appointment due to high fever and body ache, remaining in bed until recovered.
recommended_action: Follow up with the patient to reschedule the appointment once they have recovered from their illness.

note_text: Manager called an urgent meeting at the office, could not leave work. Asked for an evening slot next time.
summary: Patient missed the appointment due to an urgent work meeting and requested an evening slot for next time.
recommended_action: Reschedule the patient to an evening slot and evaluate expanding evening appointment availability.

note_text: City bus strike that day, no auto available near the colony. Distance is a big problem for him.
summary: Patient missed appointment due to a city bus strike, lack of auto availability, and long distance.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth options or provide transportation support/rescheduling during local transit strikes.

note_text: Phone was switched off, could not reach the patient after three attempts.
summary: Patient was unreachable after three contact attempts because their phone was switched off.
recommended_action: Attempt contact via alternative communication channels such as email or SMS, and verify contact information upon next patient encounter.

note_text: Had a shift change at the factory and could not take leave. Prefers Saturday appointments.
summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a factory shift change and inability to take leave. Prefers Saturday appointments.
recommended_action: Offer Saturday or weekend appointment slots to accommodate work schedule conflicts.

note_text: Bhool gaya, SMS nahi aaya tha. Dobara booking karni hai.
summary: Patient forgot the appointment stating no SMS reminder was received, and requested to rebook.
recommended_action: Investigate SMS delivery system logs for errors and assist the patient in rebooking their appointment.
